observation.visible_scene: A glossy dark-teal oval ceramic dish filled with water and several floating ice cubes, resting on a wet stone/concrete surface. A vertical water streak/reflection runs through the background. The dish rim carries pale yellow dots, and similar yellow spots are visible through the water inside the dish.
visible_changes: The water surface shows continuous, gentle shimmering: the bright reflection streaks on the water change shape and position subtly from frame to frame.
Highlights and reflections on the upright ice cube (right) and the tilted/floating cubes shift slightly, tracking the moving water surface rather than the ice itself.
The ice cubes stay in the same positions relative to the dish across the whole excerpt; no translation, rotation, or visibly progressing melt is seen.
The pale yellow dots on the rim and the dots seen through the water remain stationary.
The dish's position within the frame and the background vertical streak are unchanged, indicating a static camera.
outside_clip_unknowns: What (if anything) is causing the water's surface motion is not visible.
Whether the ice cubes will melt or drift later, or whether a disturbance preceded the first frame, is outside this segment.
uncertain_details: Whether the interior yellow spots are painted on the dish bottom seen through refracted water or reflections of the rim dots cannot be confirmed.
Any very small drift of individual ice cubes is at the limit of what these frames can confirm; they appear fixed.
